First, note that Europe/Athens is UTC+2 in modern times, but time zones were not standardized in 1333.  
Assuming the question intends to use the current UTC+2 offset for Athens year-round (no DST in 1333), we add 2 hours to 17:00 UTC.  

17:00 + 2 hours = 19:00.  
Date remains December 22, 1333.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1333-12-22 19:00
